title: Minecraft Firework
blurb: Fireworks changed Minecraft twice. First they were pure decoration, and then the Elytra made rocket-boosting the fastest way to cross the world, so this whoosh-and-crack became the sound of somebody travelling several thousand blocks in an afternoon. It is also, less charitably, the sound of a crossbow user deleting you in PvP before you have finished turning around. A complete little arc — launch, ascent, burst — which makes it useful in any edit needing a celebration, a takeoff, or an abrupt and colourful ending.
origin: The firework rocket launch and burst from Minecraft.
